response: Three-dimensional ultrasound-validated large-core needle biopsy is a reliable method for the histological assessment of breast lesions. The use of 3D ultrasound validation of the postfiring needle position is an efficient adjunct to ultrasound-guided large-core needle biopsy (LCNB). This method has several advantages, including a reduction in the number of core samples needed to achieve a reliable histological diagnosis, a possible reduction in the risk of tumor cell displacement, reduced procedure time, and lower costs. Therefore, 3D ultrasound validation can be a valuable tool in the assessment of breast lesions, providing accurate and efficient results.
